section_summary.extract_value: This section introduces 'the present study', which aims to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of a Bahasa Malaysia (Malay) translation of the BAS-2 in Malaysian adults. It reviews prior research on body appreciation in Malaysia and highlights the importance of the current study due to the lack of valid tools and the unique demographic context. The study intends to assess the factor structure, measurement invariance across gender and ethnic groups (Malaysian Malays and Malaysian Chinese), internal consistency, and construct validity, including correlations with self-reported BMI.
